text:
Maya: quick sync 1 1 planning a micro-experiment on pricing page: "MinimalCalc" vs "TierClear". objective = improve demo signups and better route inbound.
Owen: MinimalCalc = 3-question estimator, TierClear = cleaned tier bands + focused CTA. want to see which drives faster demo requests.
Jules: also test micro-FAQ variants: persona-first vs topic-first. persona-first shows startup/scale/enterprise FAQs.
CSBot: note from CS: include hidden field `enterprise=true` when domain matches allowlist. add opt-out URL for current customers.
Maya: copy ideas:
```
TierClear CTA: "Schedule a 15-minute demo"
TierClear note: "Monthly billing & SLA options available"
MinimalCalc CTA flow: "Get a quick estimate" -> quiz -> "Join webinar" or "Request demo"
```
Owen: metrics to track: `cta_click`, `estimator_started`, `estimator_completed`, `form_submitted`, `time_on_page`. targets: +10% demo clicks for TierClear, +20% estimator completes for MinimalCalc.
Jules: routing: exploratory -> webinar, evaluating -> demo, procurement -> sales. enterprise flag routes to sales inbox with tag `pricing-experiment`.
Maya: timeline: copy+design Mon, dev Tues, QA Wed, soft launch Thur. can engineering confirm dev slot Tues morning?
Owen: @growth-eng booked Tues 9am. I'll add experiment flag exp-4201 and rollout plan (5%->25%->100%).
CSBot: exp-4201 created, tags=[pricing, estimator, webinar-routing], dashboard=/dash/exp-4201.
Maya: marketing one-liner for promo: "Find the right plan for your team in under 30 seconds." keeps it simple.
Jules: I'll prep canned replies for webinar leads and update playbook.
Owen: let's keep copy concise and avoid pricing numbers publicly.
Maya: cool. will upload the doc to marketing drive and ping design + eng. :rocket:
